projects.title: SPONSORLY
projects.tagline: Replacing informal sponsorship agreements with escrow-backed milestones and verifiable proof-of-work.
projects.summary: A full-scale sponsorship marketplace bridging digital creators and commercial brands. Automates brief publishing, bidding, milestone-based escrow locks, and deliverable validation with immutable audit trails.
projects.architecture: Full-stack marketplace architecture built on Next.js and Node.js with PostgreSQL & Prisma. Redis powers low-latency search caching, live proposal room negotiation channels, and notification queues. A deterministic finite state machine (FSM) regulates campaign progression from brief publication to escrow funding and final audit verification.

projects.title: TIFFINMITRA
projects.tagline: Reliable daily meal delivery coordinated around an immutable 8:00 AM preparation cutoff.
projects.summary: Subscription logistics ecosystem connecting local home-tiffin services with students and professionals. Features interactive calendar pause/resume scheduling, automated kitchen production sheet generation, and cutoff-enforced batching.
projects.architecture: Polyglot backend architecture coupling PostgreSQL for ledger/subscription durability with MongoDB for polymorphic daily menus and regional kitchen profiles. An in-memory Redis scheduler enforces sub-millisecond calendar cutoffs, while Node.js background batch workers aggregate manifests into automated delivery dispatch routes.

experience.description: Architecting and scaling two independent full-stack platforms from system design to execution: Sponsorly (escrow-driven sponsorship marketplace) and TiffinMitra (subscription food logistics platform).
points: Constructed scalable full-stack services using TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, and Redis caching layers.
Devised dual database topologies (PostgreSQL + MongoDB) separating financial ledgers from flexible document stores.
Created production-grade Docker pipelines ensuring rapid deployment cycles and environment parity.

experience.description: Built resilient, high-speed client-facing interfaces with React and Tailwind CSS. Implemented component-driven design systems and optimized bundle sizes.
points: Decreased initial page load times by 35% through dynamic code splitting, image optimization, and memoized renders.
Integrated complex RESTful API endpoints with optimistic UI updates and error boundary fallbacks.
Authored thorough unit and integration test suites improving baseline branch reliability.
